title: aster anthylloides
intro: Aster anthylloides, commonly known as White Hedge or White Pyrethrum, is a flowering plant in the daisy family, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aster anthylloides include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating wounds, infections, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of Aster anthylloides include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
